name: The kernel proves lead de5612a2: The 42-state paired walk: doubling in Z/9 (period 6) against stepping by two in Z/7 (period 7). Coprime, so the pair has period exactly 42 and visits all 42 states before returning. Forward and inverse walks meet at step 21 (8,1) and step 42 (1,1) — two contact points per revolution.
